evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ComplexIF, a challenging benchmark for this setting, together with the automatic pipeline that generates it.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The pipeline expands seed requests into multi-turn conversations, weaves constraints into their turns, and keeps only tasks that a strong model can solve, so difficulty can be raised by adding constraints or turns while every task stays solvable.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, even the strongest satisfies every constraint on fewer than half of the verifiable tasks, and no model leads on both splits.
